policy_title: Guiding Principles for the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Teaching and Learning at RU
document_type: teaching and learning guidance and examination regulation
selection_rationale: Most explicitly generative-AI-specific Icelandic candidate found (names ChatGPT/Copilot/Gemini); University of Iceland's own AI Policy page was considered but discusses AI at a strategic level without naming generative AI specifically, so was not selected. Official domain (ru.is).
notes: Approved by Executive Council 2025-11-14, revised 2026-05. Original language not confirmed. Iceland has few institutions overall; expanding beyond RU for a full Icelandic sample will likely fall short of the 6-per-country target -- see docs/limitations.md.

exclusion_rationale: Discusses AI at an institutional-strategy level; does not name generative AI specifically as of the check performed for this pilot. Kept as a candidate for the full 30+ university expansion, where broader institutional AI policies are also in scope alongside generative-AI-specific guidance.
notes: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION before any future activation. Not scraped in the pilot.
